pr.options.LAZY_CHUNK_LOADING.tooltip.2: OFF - process all pending client tasks immediately
pr.options.LAZY_CHUNK_LOADING.tooltip.3: ON - budget client-side chunk packet processing tasks
pr.options.LAZY_CHUNK_LOADING.tooltip.4: Smooths client frametime during heavy chunk packet bursts
pr.options.LAZY_CHUNK_LOADING.tooltip.5: by limiting task queue execution on the client thread.

pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.1: Stabilises FPS by flushing the graphics driver pipeline.
pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.2: OFF - no pipeline stall, standard frame pacing (faster)
pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.3: ON - forces glFinish() pipeline flush on each frame
pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.4: Forces the CPU to wait until the GPU finishes all rendering.
pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.5: Destroys pipelining on modern GPUs (RX 6000/7000, RTX, FreeSync).
pr.options.SMOOTH_FPS.tooltip.6: Use only if experiencing uneven pacing without VSync.
pr.options.SMOOTH_WORLD.tooltip.3: ON - dynamic server tick pacing & distant mob AI culling
pr.options.SMOOTH_WORLD.tooltip.4: Synchronises integrated server ticks with client frame time
pr.options.SMOOTH_WORLD.tooltip.5: and reduces AI pathfinding for distant unengaged mobs in
pr.options.SMOOTH_WORLD.tooltip.6: singleplayer mode to prevent CPU lag spikes.
